scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:node && npm run build:browser
scripts.clean: npm run --workspaces --if-present clean && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{ recursive:true, force:true })"
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-core typecheck && npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-node typecheck && npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-browser typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-core test && npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-node test && npm run -w @unknownncat/curve25519-browser test
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:cross && npm run bench:ci
scripts.release:check: npm run ci && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts -w @unknownncat/curve25519-core && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts -w @unknownncat/curve25519-node && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts -w @unknownncat/curve25519-browser
